verdict.rationale: Jan is a local LLM inference app, so running models on specialized accelerators through plugins is a fair question for it. The evidence only says inference runs "on your hardware" and is "powered by llama.cpp". Nothing mentions TPU, Gaudi, or any accelerator plugin or backend extension mechanism.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on specialized accelerators like TPUs or Gaudi through plugin support
